name: Dalaran Pendant
summary: In Ambermill, Dalaran Pendants focus the Kirin Tor's magic. The Forsaken seek them to hinder the wizards' work and trace the source of their power.

sections.title: Amulets of Ambermill
sections.body: Kirin Tor sorcerers, conjurers, and protectors weave powerful spells in Ambermill, threatening Forsaken control of southern Silverpine Forest. Each carries an attuned Dalaran Pendant. At the Sepulcher, Shadow Priest Allister sends Forsaken operatives to recover the pendants, slowing the mages' efforts and uncovering who guides their magical weave.

faq.answer: A Dalaran Pendant is an arcane amulet carried by Kirin Tor conjurers, mages, and protectors in Ambermill. The Forsaken seek them to interrupt the wizards' workings and examine their magic.
Human mages, conjurers, and protectors of Dalaran carry the pendants in Ambermill, in Silverpine Forest.

faq.q: Why does Shadow Priest Allister want them?
faq.answer: Shadow Priest Allister and his ally Dalar need the pendants to slow the wizards' spells and pinpoint the powerful mage directing Ambermill's magical weave.
Ambermill lies in southern Silverpine Forest. From the Sepulcher, take the eastern fork off the main road heading south to reach the village.

angles.text: As an undead, taking these pendants from the Kirin Tor helps secure Silverpine Forest against human sorcerers trying to regain their foothold.
As a mage, you can see how the Kirin Tor use these pendants to focus their magic and coordinate complex spells.
